cohort: 309,573 women aged 16-49 years who gave birth to a single live infant in the UK between 2006 and 2016
finding: While most women had a consultation around the time of the postnatal check, a significant proportion did not receive a structured check, particularly teenagers and those from deprived areas.
mod_finding: Women who had a cesarean delivery had higher consultation rates in the year after childbirth.
